field_guidance.provider: Opaque confirmed integration name; reference resolves the target-owned integration document or section. Record the complete packet home, applicable authoritative limits/units with evidence and explicit undocumented capacity. Enforce known bounds in their declared units; unknown is not unlimited or a guessed cap. A confirmed native-validation recipe may permit one otherwise authorized ordinary publication with undocumented ceiling/unit under forge's common guard: retain the pre-write original, validate safe text, bind this run's actual native artifact/actor/scope and require full string-valued body/original-byte equality. Refused or unverified publication blocks dependent transitions; known locators recover GET-only, unknown creation gets one bounded read-only reconciliation and no automatic recreation or selection of an old matching artifact. Report configuration-complete separately from selected-operation delivery-ready; a refused/unverified required publication blocks delivery-ready. Ask only genuine owner choices, not undocumented provider internals. Description is default; a note home records current same-change/current-head description-pointer form and independent append/readback then pointer-update/readback refresh preserving closure syntax. Discovery, gate/Lift rebind and review follow only that pointer, never historical notes/markers. Record documented stale-head rejection or explicit probe/cleanup authority and disposable probe evidence: date, change/request locator and identity, old/current full heads, stale-bound merge refusal status/response and unmerged post-read. Setup describes, never executes, the probe; fields/schemas alone prove no guarantee. Queue head binding must survive actual merge, not only acceptance; unsupported/unproven binding returns sha-bound-action-unsupported with no unbound fallback or direct merge under queue authority.
field_guidance.profile_path: Confirmed invoked-target profile pointer, never an installed default.
field_guidance.tracker: Independently confirmed work-item system/repository or local filesystem scope, tools and operation limits.
field_guidance.agent_setup_docs: Confirmed target-relative paths preserving custom roots and additions.
field_guidance.label_vocabulary: Live target vocabulary and target triage-role mapping; no shared label default.
field_guidance.check_gate: Target policy ref, exact local command, runtime and bootstrap route.
field_guidance.dev_workflows: Target policy and runtime-specific complete declaration pointers.
field_guidance.branch_naming: Target source-branch policy, not a native identifier validator.
field_guidance.ci_parity: Independently scoped configured advisory CI and binding limits.
field_guidance.release_deploy_policy: Target policy; configuration alone never grants action authority.
field_guidance.manual_validation_rules: Target acceptance surfaces, evidence and feasibility limits.

runtime_skill_resources.execution: <skill-name>/<path> names a file inside an installed skill, not a path from the declaring file; resolve it to a real filesystem path before invoking helpers. Relative paths inside that file resolve against the directory of the file that contains them.

resource_addressing.installed_aliases: Classify by underlying source; project-owned native aliases never establish the invoked target's profile.
